newsitem.title: USA: Orckit wins HDSL contract in China.
newsitem.headline: Orckit wins HDSL contract in China.

text.p: Orckit Communications Ltd said Monday it had won a contract from China to supply the country with special modems that enables high-speed data transmissions over traditional telephone cables.
The Israeli company said it will initially deploy HDSL or High bit rate Digital Subscriber Lines in 21 cities, including Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou.
It said it will eventually cover all of China as part of the country's plans to establish a transmission system for the interconnection of Frame Relay switches between its cities.

"While the contract is expected to have only a small effect on Orckit's 1997 sales volume, this is still an important step forward for the company in the Asian market," said the company, a rival of PairGain Technologies Inc.
Orckit did not disclose the value of the deal and a spokeswoman described the amount as "minimal."
HDSL, a digital modem technology, enables telecommunications operators to offer high speed data services without having to invest in a costly infrastructure.
Orckit Communications, based in Tel Aviv, made an initial public offering last September.
On Monday, its stock was up 3/4 at 11-3/4 on the Nasdaq Stock Market.
